paper_topology: 'a tangent line', bi-degree (3,3); Fig. 10 (left) shows it as an iso-parameter line across the domain
matched: bi-degree (3,3) (both surfaces); topology: one open tangential straight line (deviation from its chord 2e-17), the iso-line u = 0 (s = 0.5) across the whole width of both sheets, normals parallel along it (max sin 0.0e+00), the sheets cross through each other (offset d u^3: second-order, odd contact) as the panel's depth order shows; appearance: refitted to the Surfaces panel from a fitted camera (el -34.11, az -51.14, roll -26.65 deg, orthographic, scale 189.6 px/unit, target at (234.2, 233.5) px): tall wavy S-step sheet and a shorter sheet of the same profile on its wall; silhouette IoU against the panel 0.889 (before: 0.857)
guessed: exact control points (the paper publishes none): fitted by eye and by silhouette/curve matching to one view; the plateau tips are seen nearly edge-on, so their length along the view is weakly constrained; the orange's tips poking out past the blue edges are only partly reproduced; the offset law d u^3 and its direction are our choice
